name: Mobile Apps with React Native
summary: One codebase, two stores: React Native and Expo with the JavaScript you already write — and an honest account of what the bridge costs and when you have to open the native project.
prerequisites: Requires JavaScript, React included — the components, the hooks and the state are the same ideas. No native experience assumed.
syllabus: React Native and Expo: the project, the runtime and the tooling
Components, styling and layout with Flexbox
Navigation, state and data from an API
Device features: camera, storage, location and notifications
Native modules, for when the library does not exist
Builds, over-the-air updates and both stores
